abstract: We present a case of a 40-yr-old woman diagnosed with a primary malignant struma ovarii. The patient was admitted with the complaint of pelvic pain and a large pelvic mass in the mid-portion of lower abdomen on gynecological examination. Pre-operative tumor markers and routine biochemistry were unremarkable. She was treated with total abdominal hysterectomy and right salpingo-oopherectomy. Post-operatively, she was diagnosed with a malignant struma ovarii through the usage of histopathological criteria similar to the guidelines for primary thyroid gland disease. The patient was subsequently performed left salpingo-oopherectomy and retroperitoneal pelvic lympadenectomy for re-staging. Although, left ovary and lymph nodes were histopathologically normal, she was offered thyroidectomy but she refused to accept the offer. Thyroglobulin level was monitored in the post-operative period. She is free of the disease for 18 months.
abstract_ja: 40歳の女性が原発性悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された症例を報告する。患者は骨盤痛と下腹部正中の大きな骨盤内腫瘤で受診した。術前の腫瘍マーカーと一般生化学検査は異常なかった。子宮全摘術と右卵管卵巣摘出術を受けた。術後、甲状腺腫瘍の病理学的基準に準じた組織学的基準により、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。その後、再病期分類のため左卵管卵巣摘出術と後腹膜骨盤リンパ節郭清を受けた。左卵巣とリンパ節は病理学的に正常であった。甲状腺摘出術を勧められたが、患者は拒否した。術後はサイログロブリン値をモニタリングした。18か月間病勢はみられていない。
